fields.reasoning: internal/api/run.go:1070 already deletes with `git branch -d` (PR #164), and run-abandon-unmerged.txtar proves the no-upstream case keeps the branch. git branch -d checks merge against the upstream when one is set, so an ahead-of-upstream branch should also be kept, but nothing tests that, and the model has no leaf recording the behavior. The change set's intent (keep unpushed commits instead of force-deleting) is therefore best served by recording the capability as a buildable leaf and pinning the untested upstream case with a script, not by rewriting working code. Runs build only childless leaves, so the work needs that leaf to ship under milestone-25.
fields.statement: Change set 01M6JWSC builds no new deletion logic: it adds one childless leaf under run-abandon saying rhiza run abandon keeps a local branch holding commits merged into neither its upstream nor HEAD, and covers it with a test for the missing case (a branch with an upstream plus local commits never pushed to it) beside the existing run-abandon-unmerged.txtar no-upstream case; the code changes only if that new test shows the branch is deleted
